Neon Kart 3D · Sunset Coast. Original game code and assets: GNU AGPL version 3 only (AGPL-3.0-only). Three.js and esbuild retain their MIT licenses.

The source download is served alongside this game. It includes editable Blender models, exported GLBs, game source, tests, build scripts, pinned dependency metadata, documentation, and notices. It does not require GitHub or ChatGPT access. Extract it, then run npm ci and npm run build to rebuild the distribution. Build dependencies are fetched from npm.
